meta.name: git-master
meta.description: Handles git work: atomic commits, rebase, squash, blame, bisect, reflog, and history questions. Use whenever a task needs a commit or a git-history investigation; skip for ordinary code edits.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理零散代码改动，变成逻辑清晰的提交记录，并追查每处修改的由来。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你每天都在提交代码，想让每次提交都有条理，也想知道某一改动是怎样来的。
copy.tagline_en: Keep a clean commit history and trace the story behind any code change.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Git daily and want clean commits and full insight into your change history.

howto.what: 它帮你管理代码版本记录：把改动拆成多个独立提交、整理或调查改动历史、查明某段代码是谁写的。它会先检查仓库状态，只执行你明确要求的事，并报告提交哈希等结果；不会擅自推送、重置或删除其他内容。
howto.when: 当任务需要提交 Git 改动、改写历史，或调查提交历史时触发；普通代码编辑不触发。

say.text: 把这些改动分成几个独立的提交，每个功能一个提交。
say.note: 会检查改动并按意图分组逐个提交。

say.text: 把当前分支 rebase 到 main，并自动压缩 fixup 提交。
say.note: 若可能已推送，会先征求同意再强推。

say.text: 查一下这个文件 10-20 行最后一次是谁改的。
say.note: 会给出提交者、哈希和改动上下文。

howto.what_en: Claude handles Git chores: it creates atomic commits, rewrites or inspects history, and traces who changed what. It checks the repo first, does only what you explicitly ask, reports hash results, and never pushes, resets, or deletes on its own.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to commit changes, rewrite history, or investigate Git history. Ordinary code edits do not trigger it.

say_en.text: Split these changes into several independent commits, one per feature.
say_en.note: Will inspect the diff and commit each group separately.

say_en.text: Rebase the current branch onto main and autosquash fixup commits.
say_en.note: Asks before force-pushing if the commits may already be pushed.

say_en.text: Blame lines 10-20 in this file to see who last changed them.
say_en.note: Will show the author, hash, and diff context.
